verseText: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David...
meaning: God promised David his family would rule over God's people forever. God kept that promise by sending Jesus to be born into David's family.

recall.question: What did the angel say Jesus would be called?

meaning.question: God promised King David that someone from his family would rule forever. How did God keep this promise?
choices: By sending Jesus to be born in David's family

application.prompt: Jesus was no ordinary baby boy. From birth, he was the Son of the Most High God, the promised Savior, and a King who would reign forever! How does knowing who Jesus really is change the way you think about His birth?
